tool_schemas.name: direction_search_by_coords
tool_schemas.description: Creates a route search job for a point-to-point trip defined by origin/destination coordinates (or existing knl_ location_ids) and optional ordered waypoints, then returns the stored job and the associated Kakao Navigation route response (from cache when use_cache is true and force_refresh is false). This endpoint normalizes any coordinate inputs into location records for auditing/replay and enforces the client_id quota when calling the provider. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if client_id/origin/destination are missing, any lat/lng is out of range, an enum value is invalid, or both location_id and coordinates are omitted for a stop; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced knl_ location_id does not exist; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client’s provider-call allowance is exhausted; raises PROVIDER_ERROR when Kakao rejects the request or returns an error.

client_id.description: Kakao Navigation API client id used for quota, caching, and auditing.

location_id.description: Existing normalized origin location id to reuse.

label.description: Optional human-friendly label for the origin used for record keeping.

origin.description: Origin specification by existing location_id or raw coordinates.

location_id.description: Existing normalized destination location id to reuse.

label.description: Optional human-friendly label for the destination used for record keeping.

destination.description: Destination specification by existing location_id or raw coordinates.

location_id.description: Existing normalized waypoint location id to reuse.

label.description: Optional waypoint label for record keeping.

items.description: Intermediate stop specified by location_id or coordinates.

waypoints.description: Optional ordered list of intermediate stops between origin and destination.

route_preference.description: Routing preference used to compute the route.

vehicle_type.description: Vehicle type used to tailor routing and restrictions.

vehicle_options.description: Provider-specific vehicle options stored with the route search for replay/auditing.

use_cache.description: Whether to reuse a cached provider response when available.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and fetch a fresh provider response.

tool_schemas.name: direction_search_by_address
tool_schemas.description: Geocodes origin_address and destination_address (creating/reusing normalized location records) and then creates a route search job between them, returning the stored job plus the Kakao Navigation route response (using cached geocode/route results when use_cache is true and force_refresh is false). The departure_at value is stored on the job for auditing and replay and may influence provider routing when supported. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, departure_at is not a valid RFC3339 date-time, or any enum value is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when the provider returns no geocode match for an address; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client_id has no remaining quota for geocoding and/or routing calls; raises PROVIDER_ERROR when Kakao returns an error for either geocoding or routing.

client_id.description: Kakao Navigation API client id used for quota, caching, and auditing.

origin_address.description: Origin address text to geocode before routing.

destination_address.description: Destination address text to geocode before routing.

departure_at.description: Optional departure timestamp for routing context (stored on the job).

route_preference.description: Routing preference used to compute the route.

vehicle_type.description: Vehicle type used to tailor routing and restrictions.

vehicle_options.description: Provider-specific vehicle options stored with the route search for replay/auditing.

use_cache.description: Whether to reuse cached provider responses when available (geocode and route).

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and fetch fresh provider responses (geocode and route).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def direction_search_by_address(client_id, origin_address, destination_address, departure_at=None, route_preference=None, vehicle_type=None, vehicle_options=None, use_cache=None, force_refresh=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0359000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0359000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _iso(dt):
        return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s2 = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
            else:
                s2 = s
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s2).astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _new_id(prefix, rows):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        existing = set(r.get("id") for r in rows if isinstance(r, dict))
        i = len(existing) + 1
        while True:
            n = i
            s = ""
            while n > 0:
                n, rem = divmod(n, 36)
                s = alphabet[rem] + s
            s = s.rjust(4, "0")
            _id = f"{prefix}_{s}"
            if _id not in existing:
                return _id
            i += 1

    def _fingerprint(obj):
        def _norm(x):
            if isinstance(x, dict):
                return {k: _norm(x[k]) for k in sorted(x.keys())}
            if isinstance(x, list):
                return [_norm(v) for v in x]
            if isinstance(x, float):
                return round(x, 7)
            return x
        raw = json.dumps(_norm(obj), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
        return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _event(events, **fields):
        ev = {
            "id": _new_id("kne", events),
            "client_id": fields.get("client_id"),
            "tool_name": fields.get("tool_name"),
            "status": fields.get("status"),
            "request_fingerprint": fields.get("request_fingerprint"),
            "location_id": fields.get("location_id"),
            "route_search_id": fields.get("route_search_id"),
            "provider_http_status": fields.get("provider_http_status"),
            "latency_ms": fields.get("latency_ms"),
            "billed_units": fields.get("billed_units", 1),
            "created_at": _iso(now),
            "updated_at": _iso(now),
        }
        events.append(ev)
        return ev

    clients = _load("api_clients.json")
    locations = _load("locations.json")
    route_searches = _load("route_searches.json")
    provider_responses = _load("provider_responses.json")
    usage = _load("api_usage_events.json")

    if not isinstance(client_id, str) or not re.match(r"^knc_[0-9A-Z]{4,}$", client_id):
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id if isinstance(client_id, str) else "unknown", tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "client_id is required and must match ^knc_[0-9A-Z]{4,}$")
    if not isinstance(origin_address, str) or not origin_address.strip():
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "origin_address is required")
    if not isinstance(destination_address, str) or not destination_address.strip():
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "destination_address is required")
    if route_preference is not None and route_preference not in ["fastest", "shortest", "freeway", "avoid_tolls", "avoid_highways"]:
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "route_preference is invalid")
    if vehicle_type is not None and vehicle_type not in ["car", "ev", "motorcycle", "truck"]:
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "vehicle_type is invalid")
    if vehicle_options is not None and not isinstance(vehicle_options, dict):
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "vehicle_options must be an object when provided")
    dep_dt = None
    if departure_at is not None:
        dep_dt = _parse_dt(departure_at)
        if dep_dt is None:
            _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
                   status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
            _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "departure_at must be RFC3339 date-time")

    use_cache = True if use_cache is None else bool(use_cache)
    force_refresh = False if force_refresh is None else bool(force_refresh)

    client = next((c for c in clients if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id") == client_id), None)
    if not client:
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "client_id not found")
    if client.get("status") != "active":
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "client is not active")

    per_min = int(client.get("quota_requests_per_minute", 0) or 0)
    per_day = int(client.get("quota_requests_per_day", 0) or 0)
    minute_ago = now - datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)
    day_ago = now - datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    recent_min = 0
    recent_day = 0
    for e in usage:
        if not isinstance(e, dict) or e.get("client_id") != client_id:
            continue
        dt = _parse_dt(e.get("created_at"))
        if not dt:
            continue
        bu = int(e.get("billed_units", 0) or 0)
        if dt >= minute_ago:
            recent_min += bu
        if dt >= day_ago:
            recent_day += bu
    if (per_min and recent_min >= per_min) or (per_day and recent_day >= per_day):
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="rate_limited", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "quota exceeded", quota_requests_per_minute=per_min, quota_requests_per_day=per_day)

    def _upsert_location_from_geocode(address_text):
        # Request fingerprint for geocode
        geo_req = {"tool": "geocode", "address": address_text.strip()}
        geo_fp = _fingerprint(geo_req)

        cached = None
        if use_cache and not force_refresh:
            for pr in provider_responses:
                if not isinstance(pr, dict):
                    continue
                if pr.get("client_id") == client_id and pr.get("entity_type") == "geocode" and pr.get("request_fingerprint") == geo_fp and pr.get("provider") == "kakao" and pr.get("status") == "fresh":
                    exp = _parse_dt(pr.get("expires_at"))
                    if exp and exp > now:
                        cached = pr
                        break

        provider_http_status = None
        resp = None
        provider_place_id = None
        lat = None
        lng = None
        if cached:
            resp = cached.get("response_json") or {}
            provider_http_status = None
            best = (resp.get("best") if isinstance(resp, dict) else None) or {}
            provider_place_id = best.get("provider_place_id")
            lat = best.get("lat")
            lng = best.get("lng")
        else:
            # deterministic pseudo-geocode based on hash
            h = hashlib.sha256(address_text.strip().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
            a = int(h[:8], 16)
            b = int(h[8:16], 16)
            lat = ((a % 18000000) / 100000.0) - 90.0
            lng = ((b % 36000000) / 100000.0) - 180.0
            provider_place_id = "kakao:" + h[:16].upper()
            resp = {
                "provider": "kakao",
                "endpoint": "geocode",
                "request_fingerprint": geo_fp,
                "best": {
                    "provider_place_id": provider_place_id,
                    "lat": lat,
                    "lng": lng,
                    "road_address": address_text.strip(),
                    "jibun_address": None,
                    "place_name": None,
                    "confidence": 0.6
                },
                "candidates": []
            }
            provider_http_status = 200
            ttl = int(client.get("cache_ttl_seconds", 0) or 0)
            created_at = now
            expires_at = created_at + datetime.timedelta(seconds=max(0, ttl))
            if expires_at <= created_at:
                expires_at = created_at + datetime.timedelta(seconds=1)
            existing_pr = next((p for p in provider_responses if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("client_id") == client_id and p.get("entity_type") == "geocode" and p.get("request_fingerprint") == geo_fp), None)
            ts = _iso(now)
            if existing_pr and existing_pr.get("status") != "purged":
                existing_pr["provider"] = "kakao"
                existing_pr["endpoint"] = "geocode"
                existing_pr["http_status"] = provider_http_status
                existing_pr["response_json"] = resp
                existing_pr["expires_at"] = _iso(expires_at)
                existing_pr["status"] = "fresh"
                existing_pr["updated_at"] = ts
            else:
                pr_id = _new_id("knp", provider_responses)
                provider_responses.append({
                    "id": pr_id,
                    "client_id": client_id,
                    "entity_type": "geocode",
                    "location_id": None,  # filled after upsert
                    "route_search_id": None,
                    "provider": "kakao",
                    "endpoint": "geocode",
                    "request_fingerprint": geo_fp,
                    "http_status": provider_http_status,
                    "response_json": resp,
                    "expires_at": _iso(expires_at),
                    "status": "fresh",
                    "created_at": ts,
                    "updated_at": ts,
                })

        # validate coords
        if not isinstance(lat, (int, float)) or not isinstance(lng, (int, float)):
            return None, geo_fp, provider_http_status, _err("FAILED", "geocode failed to produce coordinates")

        # Upsert into locations by (client_id, provider_place_id) when present
        loc = None
        if provider_place_id:
            for l in locations:
                if isinstance(l, dict) and l.get("client_id") == client_id and l.get("provider_place_id") == provider_place_id:
                    loc = l
                    break
        ts = _iso(now)
        if loc:
            # If merged, redirect to active
            if loc.get("status") == "merged" and loc.get("merged_into_location_id"):
                # follow merge chain
                cur = loc.get("merged_into_location_id")
                seen = {loc.get("id")}
                while cur and cur not in seen:
                    seen.add(cur)
                    l2 = next((x for x in locations if isinstance(x, dict) and x.get("client_id") == client_id and x.get("id") == cur), None)
                    if not l2:
                        break
                    if l2.get("status") == "active":
                        loc = l2
                        break
                    if l2.get("status") == "merged":
                        cur = l2.get("merged_into_location_id")
                        continue
                    break
            if loc.get("status") != "active":
                return None, geo_fp, provider_http_status, _err("CONFLICT", "geocoded location is not active", location_id=loc.get("id"), status=loc.get("status"))
            # update fields
            loc["source"] = "geocode"
            loc["query_text"] = address_text.strip()
            best = resp.get("best") if isinstance(resp, dict) else {}
            loc["road_address"] = best.get("road_address") if isinstance(best, dict) else loc.get("road_address")
            loc["jibun_address"] = best.get("jibun_address") if isinstance(best, dict) else loc.get("jibun_address")
            loc["place_name"] = best.get("place_name") if isinstance(best, dict) else loc.get("place_name")
            loc["lat"] = float(lat)
            loc["lng"] = float(lng)
            conf = best.get("confidence") if isinstance(best, dict) else None
            if conf is None or (isinstance(conf, (int, float)) and 0 <= float(conf) <= 1):
                loc["confidence"] = float(conf) if isinstance(conf, (int, float)) else None
            loc["updated_at"] = ts
        else:
            loc_id = _new_id("knl", locations)
            best = resp.get("best") if isinstance(resp, dict) else {}
            conf = best.get("confidence") if isinstance(best, dict) else None
            locations.append({
                "id": loc_id,
                "client_id": client_id,
                "source": "geocode",
                "query_text": address_text.strip(),
                "place_name": best.get("place_name") if isinstance(best, dict) else None,
                "road_address": best.get("road_address") if isinstance(best, dict) else address_text.strip(),
                "jibun_address": best.get("jibun_address") if isinstance(best, dict) else None,
                "region_1depth": None,
                "region_2depth": None,
                "region_3depth": None,
                "lat": float(lat),
                "lng": float(lng),
                "provider_place_id": provider_place_id,
                "confidence": float(conf) if isinstance(conf, (int, float)) else None,
                "status": "active",
                "merged_into_location_id": None,
                "created_at": ts,
                "updated_at": ts,
            })
            loc = locations[-1]

        # Attach provider_response.location_id for geocode entity
        for pr in provider_responses:
            if isinstance(pr, dict) and pr.get("client_id") == client_id and pr.get("entity_type") == "geocode" and pr.get("request_fingerprint") == geo_fp:
                pr["location_id"] = loc.get("id")
                pr["updated_at"] = ts
        return loc, geo_fp, provider_http_status, None

    # Geocode origin & destination
    o_loc, o_geo_fp, o_http, e = _upsert_location_from_geocode(origin_address)
    if e:
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=o_geo_fp, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("provider_responses.json", provider_responses)
        _save("locations.json", locations)
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return e

    d_loc, d_geo_fp, d_http, e = _upsert_location_from_geocode(destination_address)
    if e:
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=d_geo_fp, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("provider_responses.json", provider_responses)
        _save("locations.json", locations)
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return e

    # Route request fingerprint (include addresses + resolved location ids + options)
    route_req_obj = {
        "tool": "direction_search_by_address",
        "client_id": client_id,
        "origin_address": origin_address.strip(),
        "destination_address": destination_address.strip(),
        "origin_location_id": o_loc.get("id"),
        "destination_location_id": d_loc.get("id"),
        "departure_at": _iso(dep_dt) if dep_dt else None,
        "route_preference": route_preference,
        "vehicle_type": vehicle_type,
        "vehicle_options": vehicle_options or None,
    }
    req_fp = _fingerprint(route_req_obj)

    existing_rs = next((r for r in route_searches if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("client_id") == client_id and r.get("request_fingerprint") == req_fp), None)
    if existing_rs:
        rs = existing_rs
    else:
        rs_id = _new_id("knr", route_searches)
        ts = _iso(now)
        rs = {
            "id": rs_id,
            "client_id": client_id,
            "type": "direction_by_address",
            "status": "succeeded",
            "origin_location_id": o_loc.get("id"),
            "destination_location_id": d_loc.get("id"),
            "origin_address_text": origin_address.strip(),
            "destination_address_text": destination_address.strip(),
            "departure_at": _iso(dep_dt) if dep_dt else None,
            "route_preference": route_preference,
            "vehicle_type": vehicle_type,
            "vehicle_options": vehicle_options if vehicle_options is not None else None,
            "waypoints": None,
            "request_fingerprint": req_fp,
            "provider": "kakao",
            "error_code": None,
            "error_message": None,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts,
        }
        route_searches.append(rs)

    cached = None
    if use_cache and not force_refresh:
        for pr in provider_responses:
            if not isinstance(pr, dict):
                continue
            if pr.get("client_id") == client_id and pr.get("entity_type") == "route_search" and pr.get("request_fingerprint") == req_fp and pr.get("provider") == "kakao" and pr.get("status") == "fresh":
                exp = _parse_dt(pr.get("expires_at"))
                if exp and exp > now:
                    cached = pr
                    break

    provider_http_status = None
    provider_payload = None
    if cached:
        provider_payload = cached.get("response_json")
        provider_http_status = None
    else:
        ttl = int(client.get("cache_ttl_seconds", 0) or 0)
        created_at = now
        expires_at = created_at + datetime.timedelta(seconds=max(0, ttl))
        if expires_at <= created_at:
            expires_at = created_at + datetime.timedelta(seconds=1)
        provider_payload = {
            "provider": "kakao",
            "endpoint": "directions",
            "request_fingerprint": req_fp,
            "origin_location_id": o_loc.get("id"),
            "destination_location_id": d_loc.get("id"),
            "departure_at": _iso(dep_dt) if dep_dt else None,
            "route_preference": route_preference,
            "vehicle_type": vehicle_type,
            "routes": []
        }
        provider_http_status = 200
        existing_pr = next((p for p in provider_responses if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("client_id") == client_id and p.get("entity_type") == "route_search" and p.get("request_fingerprint") == req_fp), None)
        ts = _iso(now)
        if existing_pr and existing_pr.get("status") != "purged":
            existing_pr["route_search_id"] = rs.get("id")
            existing_pr["location_id"] = None
            existing_pr["provider"] = "kakao"
            existing_pr["endpoint"] = "directions"
            existing_pr["http_status"] = provider_http_status
            existing_pr["response_json"] = provider_payload
            existing_pr["expires_at"] = _iso(expires_at)
            existing_pr["status"] = "fresh"
            existing_pr["updated_at"] = ts
        else:
            pr_id = _new_id("knp", provider_responses)
            provider_responses.append({
                "id": pr_id,
                "client_id": client_id,
                "entity_type": "route_search",
                "location_id": None,
                "route_search_id": rs.get("id"),
                "provider": "kakao",
                "endpoint": "directions",
                "request_fingerprint": req_fp,
                "http_status": provider_http_status,
                "response_json": provider_payload,
                "expires_at": _iso(expires_at),
                "status": "fresh",
                "created_at": ts,
                "updated_at": ts,
            })

    _save("locations.json", locations)
    _save("route_searches.json", route_searches)
    _save("provider_responses.json", provider_responses)

    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="direction_search_by_address", status="succeeded",
           request_fingerprint=req_fp, route_search_id=rs.get("id"), provider_http_status=provider_http_status,
           billed_units=1, latency_ms=latency_ms)
    _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)

    return {
        "route_search": rs,
        "origin_location": o_loc,
        "destination_location": d_loc,
        "provider_response": provider_payload,
        "cache": {"hit": bool(cached), "expires_at": cached.get("expires_at") if cached else None},
    }

tool_schemas.name: address_search_by_place_name
tool_schemas.description: Searches Kakao place/address data for the given query and returns a page of matching normalized location candidates including coordinates and address details, with pagination controlled by limit and an opaque cursor returned for the next page. Results may be served from a cached provider response when use_cache is true unless force_refresh is true, and all calls are audited and counted against the client_id quota. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if client_id/query are missing, limit is out of range, or the cursor is malformed; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client’s search quota is exhausted; raises PROVIDER_ERROR when Kakao rejects the query or returns an upstream error.

client_id.description: Kakao Navigation API client id used for quota, caching, and auditing.

query.description: Place name or keyword to search for matching addresses/places.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

use_cache.description: Whether to reuse a cached provider response when available.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and fetch a fresh provider response.

tool_schemas.name: geocode
tool_schemas.description: Geocodes the provided address via Kakao, returning the best-match coordinates and address metadata and recording/rehydrating a normalized location for auditing and reuse. The response may be served from cache when use_cache is true unless force_refresh is true, and provider usage is recorded against the client_id quota. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if client_id/address are missing; raises NOT_FOUND if the provider returns no geocoding result for the address; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining geocode quota; raises PROVIDER_ERROR when Kakao returns an upstream error.

client_id.description: Kakao Navigation API client id used for quota, caching, and auditing.

address.description: Address text to convert into geographic coordinates.

use_cache.description: Whether to reuse a cached provider response when available.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and fetch a fresh provider response.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def geocode(client_id, address, use_cache=None, force_refresh=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0359000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0359000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _iso(dt):
        return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s2 = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
            else:
                s2 = s
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s2).astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _new_id(prefix, rows):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        existing = set(r.get("id") for r in rows if isinstance(r, dict))
        i = len(existing) + 1
        while True:
            n = i
            s = ""
            while n > 0:
                n, rem = divmod(n, 36)
                s = alphabet[rem] + s
            s = s.rjust(4, "0")
            _id = f"{prefix}_{s}"
            if _id not in existing:
                return _id
            i += 1

    def _fingerprint(obj):
        def _norm(x):
            if isinstance(x, dict):
                return {k: _norm(x[k]) for k in sorted(x.keys())}
            if isinstance(x, list):
                return [_norm(v) for v in x]
            if isinstance(x, float):
                return round(x, 7)
            return x
        raw = json.dumps(_norm(obj), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
        return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _event(events, **fields):
        ev = {
            "id": _new_id("kne", events),
            "client_id": fields.get("client_id"),
            "tool_name": fields.get("tool_name"),
            "status": fields.get("status"),
            "request_fingerprint": fields.get("request_fingerprint"),
            "location_id": fields.get("location_id"),
            "route_search_id": fields.get("route_search_id"),
            "provider_http_status": fields.get("provider_http_status"),
            "latency_ms": fields.get("latency_ms"),
            "billed_units": fields.get("billed_units", 1),
            "created_at": _iso(now),
            "updated_at": _iso(now),
        }
        events.append(ev)
        return ev

    clients = _load("api_clients.json")
    locations = _load("locations.json")
    provider_responses = _load("provider_responses.json")
    usage = _load("api_usage_events.json")

    if not isinstance(client_id, str) or not re.match(r"^knc_[0-9A-Z]{4,}$", client_id):
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id if isinstance(client_id, str) else "unknown", tool_name="geocode",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "client_id is required and must match ^knc_[0-9A-Z]{4,}$")
    if not isinstance(address, str) or not address.strip():
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="geocode",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "address is required")

    use_cache = True if use_cache is None else bool(use_cache)
    force_refresh = False if force_refresh is None else bool(force_refresh)

    client = next((c for c in clients if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id") == client_id), None)
    if not client:
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="geocode",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "client_id not found")
    if client.get("status") != "active":
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="geocode",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "client is not active")

    # Rate limit/quota
    per_min = int(client.get("quota_requests_per_minute", 0) or 0)
    per_day = int(client.get("quota_requests_per_day", 0) or 0)
    minute_ago = now - datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)
    day_ago = now - datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    recent_min = 0
    recent_day = 0
    for e in usage:
        if not isinstance(e, dict) or e.get("client_id") != client_id:
            continue
        dt = _parse_dt(e.get("created_at"))
        if not dt:
            continue
        bu = int(e.get("billed_units", 0) or 0)
        if dt >= minute_ago:
            recent_min += bu
        if dt >= day_ago:
            recent_day += bu
    if (per_min and recent_min >= per_min) or (per_day and recent_day >= per_day):
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="geocode",
               status="rate_limited", request_fingerprint=None, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "quota exceeded", quota_requests_per_minute=per_min, quota_requests_per_day=per_day)

    req_obj = {"tool": "geocode", "address": address.strip()}
    req_fp = _fingerprint(req_obj)

    cached = None
    if use_cache and not force_refresh:
        for pr in provider_responses:
            if not isinstance(pr, dict):
                continue
            if pr.get("client_id") == client_id and pr.get("entity_type") == "geocode" and pr.get("request_fingerprint") == req_fp and pr.get("provider") == "kakao" and pr.get("status") == "fresh":
                exp = _parse_dt(pr.get("expires_at"))
                if exp and exp > now:
                    cached = pr
                    break

    provider_http_status = None
    resp = None
    if cached:
        resp = cached.get("response_json") or {}
        provider_http_status = None
    else:
        h = hashlib.sha256(address.strip().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        a = int(h[:8], 16)
        b = int(h[8:16], 16)
        lat = ((a % 18000000) / 100000.0) - 90.0
        lng = ((b % 36000000) / 100000.0) - 180.0
        provider_place_id = "kakao:" + h[:16].upper()
        resp = {
            "provider": "kakao",
            "endpoint": "geocode",
            "request_fingerprint": req_fp,
            "best": {
                "provider_place_id": provider_place_id,
                "lat": lat,
                "lng": lng,
                "road_address": address.strip(),
                "jibun_address": None,
                "place_name": None,
                "confidence": 0.6
            },
            "candidates": []
        }
        provider_http_status = 200
        ttl = int(client.get("cache_ttl_seconds", 0) or 0)
        created_at = now
        expires_at = created_at + datetime.timedelta(seconds=max(0, ttl))
        if expires_at <= created_at:
            expires_at = created_at + datetime.timedelta(seconds=1)
        ts = _iso(now)
        existing_pr = next((p for p in provider_responses if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("client_id") == client_id and p.get("entity_type") == "geocode" and p.get("request_fingerprint") == req_fp), None)
        if existing_pr and existing_pr.get("status") != "purged":
            existing_pr["provider"] = "kakao"
            existing_pr["endpoint"] = "geocode"
            existing_pr["http_status"] = provider_http_status
            existing_pr["response_json"] = resp
            existing_pr["expires_at"] = _iso(expires_at)
            existing_pr["status"] = "fresh"
            existing_pr["updated_at"] = ts
        else:
            pr_id = _new_id("knp", provider_responses)
            provider_responses.append({
                "id": pr_id,
                "client_id": client_id,
                "entity_type": "geocode",
                "location_id": None,
                "route_search_id": None,
                "provider": "kakao",
                "endpoint": "geocode",
                "request_fingerprint": req_fp,
                "http_status": provider_http_status,
                "response_json": resp,
                "expires_at": _iso(expires_at),
                "status": "fresh",
                "created_at": ts,
                "updated_at": ts,
            })

    best = resp.get("best") if isinstance(resp, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(best, dict):
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="geocode",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=req_fp, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("provider_responses.json", provider_responses)
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "no geocode result")

    provider_place_id = best.get("provider_place_id")
    lat = best.get("lat")
    lng = best.get("lng")
    if not (isinstance(lat, (int, float)) and isinstance(lng, (int, float))):
        _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="geocode",
               status="failed", request_fingerprint=req_fp, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
        _save("provider_responses.json", provider_responses)
        _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "no geocode coordinates")

    # Upsert location by (client_id, provider_place_id) when present
    loc = None
    if isinstance(provider_place_id, str) and provider_place_id:
        loc = next((l for l in locations if isinstance(l, dict) and l.get("client_id") == client_id and l.get("provider_place_id") == provider_place_id), None)

    ts = _iso(now)
    if loc:
        # handle merge redirect
        if loc.get("status") == "merged" and loc.get("merged_into_location_id"):
            cur = loc.get("merged_into_location_id")
            seen = {loc.get("id")}
            while cur and cur not in seen:
                seen.add(cur)
                l2 = next((x for x in locations if isinstance(x, dict) and x.get("client_id") == client_id and x.get("id") == cur), None)
                if not l2:
                    break
                if l2.get("status") == "active":
                    loc = l2
                    break
                if l2.get("status") == "merged":
                    cur = l2.get("merged_into_location_id")
                    continue
                break
        if loc.get("status") != "active":
            _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="geocode",
                   status="failed", request_fingerprint=req_fp, billed_units=0, latency_ms=int((time.time()-t0)*1000))
            _save("provider_responses.json", provider_responses)
            _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("CONFLICT", "location is not active", location_id=loc.get("id"), status=loc.get("status"))
        loc["source"] = "geocode"
        loc["query_text"] = address.strip()
        loc["road_address"] = best.get("road_address") or loc.get("road_address")
        loc["jibun_address"] = best.get("jibun_address")
        loc["place_name"] = best.get("place_name")
        loc["lat"] = float(lat)
        loc["lng"] = float(lng)
        conf = best.get("confidence")
        if conf is None or (isinstance(conf, (int, float)) and 0 <= float(conf) <= 1):
            loc["confidence"] = float(conf) if isinstance(conf, (int, float)) else None
        loc["updated_at"] = ts
    else:
        loc_id = _new_id("knl", locations)
        conf = best.get("confidence")
        locations.append({
            "id": loc_id,
            "client_id": client_id,
            "source": "geocode",
            "query_text": address.strip(),
            "place_name": best.get("place_name"),
            "road_address": best.get("road_address") or address.strip(),
            "jibun_address": best.get("jibun_address"),
            "region_1depth": None,
            "region_2depth": None,
            "region_3depth": None,
            "lat": float(lat),
            "lng": float(lng),
            "provider_place_id": provider_place_id if isinstance(provider_place_id, str) else None,
            "confidence": float(conf) if isinstance(conf, (int, float)) else None,
            "status": "active",
            "merged_into_location_id": None,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts,
        })
        loc = locations[-1]

    # attach provider_response.location_id
    for pr in provider_responses:
        if isinstance(pr, dict) and pr.get("client_id") == client_id and pr.get("entity_type") == "geocode" and pr.get("request_fingerprint") == req_fp:
            pr["location_id"] = loc.get("id")
            pr["updated_at"] = ts

    _save("locations.json", locations)
    _save("provider_responses.json", provider_responses)

    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    _event(usage, client_id=client_id, tool_name="geocode", status="succeeded",
           request_fingerprint=req_fp, location_id=loc.get("id"),
           provider_http_status=provider_http_status, billed_units=1, latency_ms=latency_ms)
    _save("api_usage_events.json", usage)

    return {
        "location": loc,
        "provider_response": resp,
        "cache": {"hit": bool(cached), "expires_at": cached.get("expires_at") if cached else None},
    }

tool_schemas.name: future_direction_search_by_coords
tool_schemas.description: Creates a future-departure route search job using origin/destination coordinates (or knl_ location_ids), a required departure_at timestamp, and optional waypoints, then returns the stored job and Kakao’s route response computed with future traffic context when supported. Coordinate inputs are normalized into location records, and the provider call is cached/audited and counted against the client_id quota (unless satisfied from cache under use_cache and not force_refresh). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if departure_at is missing/invalid, any stop is missing both location_id and coordinates, coordinates are out of range, or enum values are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced knl_ location_id does not exist; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client’s routing quota is exhausted; raises PROVIDER_ERROR when Kakao rejects the request or returns an upstream error.

client_id.description: Kakao Navigation API client id used for quota, caching, and auditing.

location_id.description: Existing normalized origin location id to reuse.

label.description: Optional human-friendly label for the origin used for record keeping.

origin.description: Origin specification by existing location_id or raw coordinates.

location_id.description: Existing normalized destination location id to reuse.

label.description: Optional human-friendly label for the destination used for record keeping.

destination.description: Destination specification by existing location_id or raw coordinates.

departure_at.description: Future departure timestamp used for traffic prediction routing.

location_id.description: Existing normalized waypoint location id to reuse.

label.description: Optional waypoint label for record keeping.

items.description: Intermediate stop specified by location_id or coordinates.

waypoints.description: Optional ordered list of intermediate stops between origin and destination.

route_preference.description: Routing preference used to compute the route.

vehicle_type.description: Vehicle type used to tailor routing and restrictions.

vehicle_options.description: Provider-specific vehicle options stored with the route search for replay/auditing.

use_cache.description: Whether to reuse a cached provider response when available.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and fetch a fresh provider response.

label.description: Optional human-friendly label for the origin used for record keeping.

vehicle_type.description: Vehicle type used to tailor routing and restrictions.

Refuses invalid credentials and returns suspended/deleted status without allowing tool execution.

Refuses cancellation for succeeded/failed/cancelled jobs, missing jobs, inactive clients, or quota-exceeded requests; always records an api_usage_events row.
